summary.en: Backend lead engineer and hands-on technical lead with 6+ years delivering Java-based warehouse automation systems from offices and customer sites in Malaysia and China. label.zh: AI 辅助 WMS 故障排查原型

stage.zh: 内部原型 - 尚未发布

summary.en: Designed a retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) assistant to make warehouse automation troubleshooting knowledge easier to access when inventory or process failures occurred.
summary.zh: 设计一套检索增强生成（RAG）助手，让工程人员在库存或流程异常发生时更容易获取仓储自动化故障排查知识。

text.en: Ran a compact language model on a project server and used RAG to retrieve relevant workflow documentation and diagrams, suggesting where support engineers could begin an investigation.
text.zh: 在项目服务器上运行小型语言模型，并通过 RAG 检索相关流程文档和图表，为支持工程师建议故障调查的起点。

text.en: Would extend retrieval to source-code context and read-only database queries so the assistant could narrow likely failure causes and provide diagnostic guidance without exposing proprietary code to end users.
text.zh: 计划把检索范围扩展到源代码上下文及只读数据库查询，使助手能够缩小潜在故障原因范围，并在不向最终用户暴露专有代码的情况下提供诊断指引。

statusNote.en: Work concluded at prototype stage when the role ended; it was not released to customers or operated in production.
statusNote.zh: 该工作在任职结束时止于原型阶段，未向客户发布，也未在生产环境中运行。

evidenceNeeded: exact model, runtime, and application framework
document ingestion, chunking, embedding, and retrieval design
observed failure cases and hallucination controls
permission, privacy, and source-code isolation design
